name: Nigeria
disclaimer: General information to help you organise your record. It is not legal advice. Some laws apply only in states that have adopted them. If your employer is a government body, a short time limit may apply, so get advice quickly.

lawyerHelp.label: Free legal help (Legal Aid Council of Nigeria)

statutes.name: Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria 1999, section 42
statutes.summary: Guarantees freedom from discrimination because of community, ethnic group, place of origin, sex, religion or political opinion. Fundamental rights claims are not subject to ordinary limitation periods.

statutes.name: Constitution (Third Alteration) Act 2010, s.254C
statutes.summary: Gives the National Industrial Court power over cases of sexual harassment at work, workplace discrimination and unfair labour practice.

limitation.label: If your employer is a public body
limitation.note: Claims against government employers and public officers generally must be brought within three months (Public Officers Protection Act). Private employers usually have longer.

statutes.name: Labour Act (Cap L1, LFN 2004)
statutes.summary: Sets rules on wages, working hours, contracts and leave for workers, and lets you complain to a labour officer.

agency.name: Federal Ministry of Labour and Employment

statutes.name: Discrimination Against Persons with Disabilities (Prohibition) Act 2018
statutes.summary: Prohibits discrimination against people with disabilities, including at work, and requires reasonable accommodation.

agency.name: National Commission for Persons with Disabilities

statutes.name: Violence Against Persons (Prohibition) Act 2015
statutes.summary: Criminalises many forms of violence, including physical, sexual and psychological abuse, intimidation and harassment. Applies in the FCT and in states that have adopted it.

agency.name: The police, or the National Human Rights Commission

statutes.name: Employee's Compensation Act 2010
statutes.summary: Provides compensation for work-related injury, illness or disability, including mental stress arising from work.

support.name: National Human Rights Commission
support.description: Complaints about human rights abuses, free of charge.
